title: "Now You See It, Now You Don't!" Captain Henry S. Shields, HQ USAFE/INOMP, September 19, 1976
doc_notes: This document is a declassified USAF report detailing a 1976 UAP encounter involving Imperial Iranian Air Force F-4 pilots over Tehran, featuring significant redactions.

incidents.summary: Two Imperial Iranian Air Force F-4 Phantoms intercepted multiple unidentified objects over Tehran, experiencing instrumentation and communication failures.
incidents.quote: The following article recounts just such an episode as reported by two F-4 Phantom crews of the Imperial Iranian Air Force during late 1976.
